subtitle: Position approval (module «Έγκριση Θέσεων») · State Health Services Organisation (SHSO)

areas.conflict: Conflict of interest and out of office

instructions.purpose: It holds the test cases for the user acceptance test (UAT) of eHire, the first module «Έγκριση Θέσεων». Each case says who signs in, what to do and what should happen. You record the result next to it. The Summary sheet counts the results by itself and shows whether the exit criteria are met.
run: Open the sheet “Test cases”. Pick a case with the Result cell still empty. Read the whole row first.
Open the address above. Sign in with the test account named in the column “Role and test account”. The owner gives you the shared password in person; it is never written here.
Check the preconditions. Some cases build on the result of an earlier case; the Preconditions column says which.
Follow the numbered steps in order. Quote on-screen texts exactly as shown: they are written in quotation marks in the steps and in the expected result.
Compare what you see with the Expected result, point by point. If one point differs, the case fails.
Use only invented data. Never type a real staff name, request or document. Test accounts are named test.<name> and their emails end in @test.invalid, so no real mail can go out.

When you create users, lists or requests of your own, start the username or code with test. or T- and end names with “(test)” or “(δοκιμή)”. The clear-up before go-live removes only data marked in this way.
record: Choose the Result from the drop-down list: Pass, Fail, Blocked or Not run.
Write your name in Tester and the date in Date (dd/mm/yyyy).
For every Fail, write in Comments what you saw instead (a screenshot helps), open a line on the sheet “Defects” and write its number in “Defect no.”.
For Blocked, write in Comments what stopped you (for example an earlier case failed or the data is missing).
After a fix, run the case again, change the Result and add the retest on the sheet “Defects”.
results_table: Every point of the expected result happened.
At least one point did not happen, or something unexpected happened.
You could not run the case. It counts as not run.
Not yet tried. An empty Result counts the same way.
priority_table: Part of the main flow or a rule about who may see or do something. All High cases must be run.
A rule or a screen that people use less often, or a check on messages and layout.
Useful to know, with little effect on the work.
instructions.accounts_intro: The usernames below are the ones that “flask load-test-data” creates. All accounts share one password, which the owner gives you. Full names on screen end with “(δοκιμή)”. Every account opens in Greek, except test.demo.admin, which opens in English; switch it with the language links at the top right.

instructions.scope_h: In scope and out of scope
scope: In scope: the position approval flow, Settings (users, role holders, lists), the Excel import, the eFinance link (cost centres and the budget check, without amounts), the audit log and the list export.

Out of scope for now: sign-in with Active Directory, real email sending, deposits to eArchive, ΟΑΥ activity figures served by eFinance, and budget amounts. A line about eArchive may appear on a request page; ignore it. The financial figures are typed by hand.

While the eFinance link is on, eFinance does not know the test cost centres (codes T-). The cards of steps 2 and 4 then show a warning, and a “Yes” needs a comment in every case, also where the steps do not say so.

instructions.edit: On “Test cases” only the columns Result, Tester, Date, Comments and Defect no. On “Defects” every column. Do not edit the Summary: it holds formulas only.
instructions.refs: R, T, C, W, O and B codes are the rule ids of docs/contracts/02-state-machine.md (R route, T transition, C who gets a task, W time rule, O owner decision, B budget check). “03 §n” is section n of docs/contracts/03-routes-forms.md; “01” is docs/contracts/01-data-model.md; “07 §n” is section n of docs/contracts/07-efinance-link.md.

cases_note: Fill in the last five columns only. Filter with the arrows in the header.

summary.title: Summary of the test
summary.c1: Every High-priority case has been run (Pass or Fail)
summary.c2: No High-priority case has the result Fail
summary.c3: Share of all cases that passed
summary.threshold_label: Pass-rate threshold (a value you can change)
summary.decision_note: GO only when all three criteria are met. An empty workbook shows NO-GO.
summary.lists_note: The drop-downs and the formulas read these cells. Change a word here and everything follows.

defects.title: Defect log
defects.note: One line per defect. Number them DEF-001, DEF-002 and so on. The severity definitions are in the plan.
severity_defs: The flow stops, a person sees or does what the rules forbid, or data is lost.
A rule or a main screen gives a wrong result, but there is a way round.
A wrong message, label or detail that does not change the outcome.
